children: UK infrastructure and construction firm's FY26 revenue rose 7.5%, adjusted EPS up 8.8% yr/yr
Company achieved average net cash position for first time in over a decade
£25 mln share buyback announced in March 2026, over 30% complete at year-end
Kier expects FY27 earnings at the top end of the Board’s prior expectations
Company updates medium-term targets: mid-single digit revenue growth, 4.0-4.5% margin, >£200m net cash by FY29
Kier will not invest in new Property developments from FY27, reallocating capital to core businesses
INFRASTRUCTURE GROWTH - Co said strong revenue and profit growth in Infrastructure division was driven by increased project activity, especially in water, highways, and rail sectors
CONSTRUCTION MOMENTUM - Co attributed Construction division's revenue growth to ramp up of significant project works and continued contract selection discipline
ORDER BOOK EXPANSION - Co said record order book and recent contract awards provided strong forward visibility and underpinned future revenue growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Kier Group PLC is GBp268.50, about 8.3% above its September 14 closing price of GBp248.00
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
Sept 14 - UK government seeks to acquire insolvent specialist steelmaker

Sept 14 - UK government hosts meeting with business leaders to discuss growth
